svg.title: Fitmonk recommended onboarding flow
svg.desc: 11-step onboarding for Fitmonk across 8 phases: auth, welcome, body and goals, fitness setup, nutrition, plan build, paywall, activation

g.text: Google sign-in (Firebase) · user identified before onboarding begins
App value prop splash · kg / lbs toggle · cm / ft toggle
Weight loss / muscle gain / keep fit · goal weight · target date
Special event: Wedding / Trip / Reunion… · 'Visible aim = faster results'
Experience level · schedule (days + session duration) · injuries to avoid
Dietary type (veg / vegan / Jain / keto…) · food allergies optional
BMI · TDEE estimate · body profile · intermediate reveal before paywall
Loader with checkmarks · plan reveal · goal projection with target date
Today → Day 5 reminder → Day 7 billing · optional annual upsell
Push notifications · daily readiness check-in preview · unique to Fitmonk
